intent_en: To establish the millennial demographic as a mature generation of adults transitioning from education to the workforce and career paths.
previous_intent: To introduce the millennial generation (born ~1980-1996) as a significant demographic cohort now entering adulthood, the workforce, and the business environment.
narration_support: And millennials are now officially full grown adults. The youngest are graduating college and entering the job market. The oldest are well into their careers.
chart_support: Population pyramid chart titled 'MILLENNIALS ~1980-1996' highlighting the millennial age range (approx. 18-39) with blue and pink bars, accompanied by icons of a graduation cap and briefcase representing education and employment.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly describes millennials as adults graduating and entering careers. The chart visualizes this by highlighting the corresponding age cohort in a population pyramid and using icons (graduation cap, briefcase) to symbolize the life stages mentioned.
